The '''Crimson Prowler Lightsaber crystal''' was a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|Lightsaber crystal]] sold by [[6U-N5]] in the [[Republic outpost (Felucia)|Republic outpost]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. It came with the [[Crimson Prowler Lightsaber]]. The blade was characterized by a unique, sparkling aura.

==Behind the scenes==
The Crimson Prowler Lightsaber Crystal first appeared in "[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)]]." It has the same effect as the [[Bravis Sith Lightsaber Crystal]], the only difference being the name.
